meta.title: [BRIEF-240] feat: Regenerate Route
meta.body:
### Overview

Adds `POST /api/repos/:repoId/pulls/:prNumber/regenerate` (`regenerate-brief`, external-write), the HTTP half of the Regenerate button. The route re-reads the repository on the viewer's token before it calls #1034's `regenerateFailedHead`, as the api's mutation rule asks of every mutating route. The gate's push bit can be a minute old, and this write queues a paid run. No push access answers 404 and queues nothing. A GitHub that can't answer gives 502. It is declared `requiresPushAccess`, `requiresInstallation` and `requiresStoredPullRequest`, so an outside author or a url-box row gets the gate's 404.

Two new 409 wire codes, added by the recipe with their `errors.*` and `pulls.briefError.*` lines: `generation-held` (a live claim holds the head) and `generation-not-regenerable` (the head is not failed, or failed with a cannot-help code). It was `generation-not-retryable` until review. CONTEXT.md keeps "retry" for graphile's own attempts, so the wire code now uses the button's word. Success is 202 with no body. The CLI map marks the operation `webOnly`.

The `pulls.briefError.generation-*` copy is new and needs Idan's read.

### Verification

Verification at 3ea0ff091: `pnpm lint` 0 against the parent tip, and typecheck and test 0 for contract, i18n, api and cli, each real-Postgres suite on a fresh database. `/verify` against a live API is still owed, because the repos gate needs an App user sign-in.
